title: Make desktop icons and desktop widgets live on the same layer so they can't overlap one another
line: Desktop icons no longer end up hidden under widgets: new, sorted and dropped icons skip the space widgets cover, and icons move aside when a widget is moved, resized or added over them.
explanation: Desktop icons (the Folder View grid) and widgets (the applets layout) are separate layers that don't know about each other, so icons could be dropped, created or sorted into grid cells under a widget, and moving a widget over icons hid them; hidden icons could only be reached by rubber-band selection. The desktop now tells the icon positioner which cells widgets cover: new icons and dropped icons go to the nearest free uncovered cell, sorted icons flow around widgets (and re-flow when a widget moves), and when the user moves, resizes or adds a widget over icons in manual arrangement, those icons move to the nearest free cells.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: keep desktop icons out from under widgets

Icons and widgets live on separate layers, so new, sorted or dropped
icons could end up under a widget, as could icons a widget was moved
over. Icons now skip cells widgets cover and move out from under them.

BUG: 519851

media.caption: Dragging Todo.txt onto the clock widget: the icon disappears under it and clicking there opens the clock instead
Dropping Notes.txt onto the clock with the fix: it lands in the nearest free cell next to the clock
Two new files created on the desktop: both are placed under the clock (only their edges peek out)
Same two new files with the fix: they skip the cells under the clock
Icons sorted by name: Shopping.txt and Todo.txt are hidden under the clock
Sorted by name with the fix: the icons flow around the clock
Moving the clock onto the icons: Todo.txt, Music and Photos end up hidden under it
Same move with the fix: the covered icons move to the nearest free spots

review.text: The media show it working, but this is the large redesign Nate described in c2, done as ~330 lines bolted onto FolderView.qml and Positioner, with geometry checks, nearest-free-cell search and icon moves in QML. It also adopts exactly the behaviour Nate called "madness" (moving a widget rearranges icons) without maintainer agreement, while a desktop icons refactor has been announced. Positioner is fragile, and a QML/C++ split of this logic would be hard to maintain or port.
changes: Agree on the design with the desktop containment maintainers (Nate, the icons refactor owners) before landing; if it goes in, aim it at the refactor rather than the current Positioner.

Limit the change to the uncontroversial part: new, dropped and sorted icons skip cells covered by widgets. Drop pushing existing icons when a widget is moved, resized or added unless maintainers ask for it.
Do the covered-cell computation and the nearest-free-cell search in C++ (Positioner takes the widget rects), with QML only passing the geometries, and add a Positioner autotest for the blocked cells.
